This pattern, a facility with no listing in wholesale or colocation-focused data center directories, is consistent with an incumbent telephone central office rather than a modern multi-tenant colocation facility; AT&T (through its predecessor Pacific Bell and successor entities) has operated a dense network of such central offices across California for over a century, most of which host telephone switching equipment and, increasingly, network and edge computing gear rather than being marketed as commercial data centers. Palmdale sits in the Antelope Valley, a high-desert area of northern Los Angeles County with a modest telecom and light-industrial presence relative to the county's coastal core. No square footage, power capacity, or year-built figure was located for this specific building in sourcing reachable this session, and this entry does not assert AT&T's current operational role at the address beyond the facility name tag itself.
